name: ghost
reason: Large mixed JavaScript and TypeScript monorepo (about 9k files). Scale benchmark for BA-28/BA-17: wall time and peak memory of a full analysis. Budgets are the measured run plus 10% (S1 no-regression rule). Measured 2026-11-03 after Wave 3 (main 09aa02f, 16-core Windows 11, Bun 1.4.4): 7,174 of 9,171 files analyzed, 768 s wall time, 11,431 MiB peak RSS, 1.6 GB output. The audit-era run (2026-10-29) took about 26 min. Memory and output size are the open BA-17 work (streamed per-file shards, compact storage).

apps/* — React admin and portal apps (TSX)
